shared_elements: low-relief carving on a large upright slab/pillar
rows of repeated small signs/symbols forming a band
human or anthropomorphic figures with raised arms
justification: Both surfaces are upright relief-carved slabs divided into an upper figural zone above dense horizontal bands of repeated small signs, and both include profile animals and small anthropomorphic forms with raised limbs. But the content differs fundamentally: A shows large isolated wild animals (a snarling quadruped, a reptile, a long-necked bird) with abstract pillar-top motifs and no coherent scene, while B shows a formal scene of standing costumed human figures with offerings beneath a rayed disc above extensive rows of readable script, in a naturalistic, canonical figural style unlike A's bold schematic animal reliefs.
